issues: Order-row cells show raw UUIDs for Commission (id) and Piece (design_id); at 390px the long id wraps across 2 lines and the value/status column becomes very tight. Consider a short display id (first 8 chars) or a friendly commission code.
Eyebrow date is hard-coded 'Wednesday, 04 June' in StaffDashboardPage.jsx line 66 - not dynamic; feels off for a live dashboard.

action_items: (Optional polish) Render a short/friendly commission id in the staff orders table instead of full UUID; helps mobile layout.
(Optional polish) Replace hard-coded 'Wednesday, 04 June' eyebrow with today's date.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffDashboardPage.jsx uses `order.id.toLowerCase()` for data-testid; if the API ever returns an order without id (or numeric id) this will throw. Guard with `String(order.id ?? '').toLowerCase()`.
StaffDashboardPage.jsx fetch has no cleanup / abort on unmount - a stale response from a previous token could setOrders after logout. Use AbortController inside the useEffect.
StaffDashboardPage.jsx: `order.production_status.toLowerCase().replaceAll(...)` in the status-dot classname will crash if production_status is null. Add a fallback.

server.py startup seed (lines 51-57) checks for one sample order but if the sample customer's email pre-exists (from prior seeding with different id), `db.users.insert_one` will raise DuplicateKeyError because of the unique email index created 4 lines above. Wrap in try/except or upsert by email.
server.py:263 CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router; while it still works, convention is to add middleware before router mount (carried over from prior iteration).
